description_en: Creates an image from a specified instance
description_zh: 调用CreateImage从所在实例创建一份镜像
name: CreateImage

parameters.help_en: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic release of the instance after the image is packaged and uploaded. This parameter is supported only for build instances.

true: The image is released together with the instance when the instance is released.
false: The image is retained when the instance is released.
If this parameter is left empty, the default value is false
parameters.help_zh:
镜像打包上传成功后是否自动释放实例，仅支持构建机。

true：释放实例时，该镜像随实例一起释放。
false ：释放实例时，保留该镜像，不随实例一起释放。
为空则表示默认为false
parameters.name: delete_after_image_upload

parameters.help_en: The region of the destination OSS bucket where the image is stored
parameters.help_zh: 镜像要存储的目标OSS的区域
parameters.name: target_oss_region_id

parameters.example:
取值
true：附带数据盘
false：默认值，不附带数据盘
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include data cloud disks when creating the image
parameters.help_zh: 创建镜像是否包含数据盘
parameters.name: with_data_disks

Code.description_en: The business return code. A value of 0 indicates success
